notes.title: Access GladMort's settings with ease
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]Following numerous feedbacks from players having difficulties accessing the settings menu, we have added a new screen at game launch[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079901/30144ccd7ab0c64ab8d161a57bcb6c58d3949f75.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Simply press the TAB key on your keyboard to open the graphics and input mapping.

We hope this minor update will resolve the difficulties encountered by some players.[url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079901/30144ccd7ab0c64ab8d161a57bcb6c58d3949f75.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079901/68e6b956ae78111a30a7905a2aab3b273ae83d96.jpg"][/img][/url][/p]
